en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani narrated to me. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us, from Thabit and Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb, from Anas. H; Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us, from Thabit and Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. H; Qutaybah narrated to us. Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah and Abd al-Aziz, from Anas. H; Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Ghubari narrated to us. Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Abu Uthman, from Anas. H; Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Muadh ibn Hisham narrated to us. My father narrated to me, from Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Yahya ibn Adam, Umar ibn Sa'd, and Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, all from Sufyan, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. All of them narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him) that he freed Safiyyah and made her freedom her bridal gift. In Muadh's narration from his father it says: He married Safiyyah and made her freedom her bridal gift.
de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani überlieferte mir. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns, from Thabit and Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb, from Anas. H; Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns, from Thabit and Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. H; Qutaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Awanah überlieferte uns, from Qatadah and Abd al-Aziz, from Anas. H; Muhammad ibn Ubayd al-Ghubari überlieferte uns. Abu Awanah überlieferte uns, from Abu Uthman, from Anas. H; Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Muadh ibn Hisham überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir, from Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. H; Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Adam, Umar ibn Sa'd, and Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns, all from Sufyan, from Yunus ibn Ubayd, from Shu'ayb ibn al-Habhah, from Anas. All of them narrated from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) that he befreite Safiyyah and made her befreiteom her Brautgabe. In Muadh's narration from his father it says: He married Safiyyah and made her befreiteom her Brautgabe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Affan narrated to us. Hammad ibn Salamah narrated to us. Thabit narrated to us, from Anas. He said: On the day of Khaybar I rode behind Abu Talhah, and my foot touched the foot of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: We came to them when the sun had risen, and they had brought out their livestock and gone out with their axes, baskets, and digging tools. They said: Muhammad and the army. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Khaybar is destroyed. When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned. Allah, mighty and majestic, defeated them, and a beautiful girl fell to the share of Dihyah. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) bought her for seven heads, then gave her to Umm Sulaym to prepare and adorn her for him. He said, and I think he said: She was to observe her waiting period in her house. She was Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) made her wedding feast dates, dried curds, and clarified butter. The ground was cleared in places, leather mats were brought and spread, and the dried curds and clarified butter were brought. The people ate their fill. He said: The people said: We do not know whether he married her or took her as a slave mother. They said: If he veiled her, she was his wife, and if he did not veil her, she was a slave mother. When he wanted to mount, he veiled her. She sat on the rear of the camel, and they knew that he had married her. When they came near Madinah, the she-camel al-Adba stumbled. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fell, and she fell. He stood and shielded her while the women came into view and said: May Allah drive away the Jewess. I said: Abu Hamzah, did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fall? He said: Yes, by Allah, he did fall.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Affan überlieferte uns. Hammad ibn Salamah überlieferte uns. Thabit überlieferte uns, from Anas. He sagte: On the day of Khaybar I rode behind Abu Talhah, and my foot touched the foot of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). He sagte: We came to them when the Sonne had risen, and they had brought out their livestock and gone out with their axes, baskets, and digging tools. They sagte: Muhammad and the Heer. He sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sagte: Khaybar is destroyed. When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned. Allah, mighty and majestic, defeated them, and a beautiful girl fiel to the share of Dihyah. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) bought her for seven heads, then gave her to Umm Sulaym to prepare and adorn her for him. He said, and I think he sagte: She was to observe her waiting period in her house. She was Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) made her Hochzeitsmahl Datteln, getrockneten Quark, and geklärte Butter. The ground was cleared in places, leather mats were brought and spread, and the getrockneten Quark and geklärte Butter were brought. The people ate their fill. He sagte: The people sagte: We do not know whether he married her or took her as a Sklavenmutter. They sagte: If he veiled her, she was his Ehefrau, and if he did not veil her, she was a Sklavenmutter. When he wanted to mount, he veiled her. She sat on the rear of the Kamel, and they knew that he had married her. When they came near Medina, the she-Kamel al-Adba stumbled. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fiel, and she fiel. He stood and shielded her while the women came into view and sagte: May Allah drive away the Jüdin. I sagte: Abu Hamzah, did der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) fall? He sagte: Yes, by Allah, he did fall. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
